A gutted [[Jukebox/Legends|jukebox]] from '''Mos Espa's first cantina''' had been used to fabricate a storage cupboard that was kept in the [[Skywalker home/Legends|Skywalker home]] on [[Slave Quarters Row/Legends|Slave Quarters Row]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="Inside" /> by [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|I}}, as depicted in ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]'', to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> an illegal alta-wave calibration device was sat by the store's back door.<ref name="Inside" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mos Espa's first cantina was first mentioned in the [[2000]] reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]'', which was written by [[Kristin Lund]].<ref name="Inside" />
